message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I found myself feeling like a gloriously over-prepared person. My trusty flashlight was ready to go, and I had a fully charged power bank on hand for my phone. I even dug out my battery-operated lanterns to light up the living room, turning the situation into an impromptu family game night! It was a cozy reminder that being prepared doesn’t just mean having the right gear; it can also help you make the best of an unexpected moment. Do you have any tips for making power outages more enjoyable?
